## About
Domingo Lopez has worked on both sides of the car business: repair and diagnostics, and accessories and installs. He kept seeing the dealer side blame the aftermarket and the aftermarket blame the dealer, with the customer stuck in the middle. So he started Fully Loaded Automotive to bridge that gap.
Whether it's a new stereo in your truck, a push-to-start conversion, or tracking down a problem nobody else could find, the goal is the same. Do the diagnostics right, install quality parts the way the manufacturer intended, and stand behind the work.
Domingo lives in this community and is proud to be part of it. Thank you to everyone who has trusted us with their vehicle. We're rated 5 from 30 Google reviews.

## Services
- Car Audio Sales and Services: Stereo upgrades and car audio service. One reviewer had his Tundra's system upgraded and praised the sound quality.
- Complete Upfitter Sales and Services: Upfitting sales and installation for your vehicle.
- Push-To-Start Conversion: Convert your vehicle to push-to-start.
- Custom Car Audio Fabrication and Factory Style Installations: Custom fabrication and installs that keep your vehicle looking factory.
- Remote Start/ Security (Alarm) Sales and Service: Remote start and alarm systems, sold and serviced.
- Automotive Lighting Sales and Service: Lighting sales and installation.
- Window Tint/ Color Change Vinyl and Paint Protection Film Sales and Service: Tint, color change vinyl and paint protection film.
- Vehicle Diagnostics and Repair With Electrical Diagnostic And Repair: Finding the real problem, including electrical issues, and fixing it.

## FAQ
Q: Do you only do audio and accessories, or repairs too?
A: Both. Along with audio and upfitting, Domingo handles diagnostics and repair, including electrical work and brakes.

Q: Can I upgrade my stereo and keep the factory look?
A: Yes. Factory style installations are part of what we do, and one reviewer said that's exactly what he got in his Tundra.

Q: What if the service I need isn't listed?
A: Give us a call and ask. The list isn't everything we work on.

Q: How do I get on the schedule?
A: Use Book Now, send a work request through the contact form, or email FullyloadedautomotiveSA@gmail.com. We'll get back to you.
